name: Toro
outlook:
What Toro says to expect

  • Full year fiscal 2026: net sales growth and adjusted EPSThe company is raising its full-year net sales and *adjusted EPS guidance and now expects total company net sales growth in the range of 6.3% to 6.6%, up from the previous range of 4.0% to 6.5%, and *adjusted EPS in the range of $4.60 to $4.65, up from the previous range of $4.50 to $4.62.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
